title: WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models
selection_reason: The abstract identifies repeated target-model forward passes as the closed-loop latency bottleneck in autoregressive VLA policies and adds world-aware prefill to speculative decoding; it reports 1.5x matched-success speedup. The deployment domain is robotics/VLA, but the concrete method is LLM-style speculative inference acceleration.
